summary.what_this_system_is: A background system that runs inside the MTI platform core. It is driven by the Personal Assistant. The Personal Assistant is the single entry point for every person. It reads the code, shows the identity card, asks for the password, then opens the work hub for that identity.
summary.what_this_system_is_not: This system does not replace the legal partner. It does not replace the accounting partner. It does not replace the auditor. It does not give legal opinions. It does not give accounting opinions. It coordinates, routes, records, and computes.
summary.scope: MTI platform only. This file covers the Fintech Lawyer partner, the Accountant and Auditor partner, and all client entry paths B2B, B2C, C2C for the MTI platform only.

principles.partners_system: One partner per task. One task per partner. No two partners do the same work. No overlap.
principles.data_rule: Data is never sold. Data is used as paid services only.
principles.documentation_rule: No verbal work. Every task is written, stamped, recorded, and stored in the core.
principles.official_framework: All partner work runs inside a legal and accounting framework that is formally recognized by the State, official authorities, banks, and global and international bodies.
principles.code_decides_path: Code decides path. Personal Assistant reads the code first, then opens the path. No code means guest path only. A wrong code means no entry.
principles.one_session_one_code_one_path: One session uses one code and one path. To change role, close the session and enter again with the other code.

definitions.deal: A closed transaction executed through a deal contract on the MTI platform.
definitions.deal_contract: The signed contract that defines a deal, its value, and the MTI commission for that deal.
definitions.deal_commission: The MTI commission stated in a deal contract for one deal.
definitions.total_deal_commissions_collected: The sum of all MTI deal commissions actually collected from deal contracts in a given period. This is the ONLY base for the 3 percent partner shares.
definitions.platform_operation: A platform operation that is a deal under a deal contract. Only deal-type operations count toward the base.
definitions.subscription: A recurring platform subscription paid by an exporter or importer. Subscriptions are NOT deal commissions and are NOT part of the base.
definitions.total_income: All income of MTI from all sources. Total income is NOT the base.
definitions.net_profit: MTI income after all costs. Net profit is NOT the base.
definitions.membership: An approved account on MTI with a code and a password. Membership is created at first entry and approved on the platform. It is used for every later entry.
definitions.identity_card: A graphic card shown after code entry with full identity: name, company or institution, official entity, role, code, member since, status.

commission_base.rule: Each partner receives 3 percent of total deal commissions collected from deal contracts - commissions on deals or platform operations that are deals only.
commission_base.timing: Before any deduction. The base is measured before bank charges, taxes, salaries, subscriptions payable, Escrow fees, or any other cost.
commission_base.payment_timing: Each partner is paid only together with actual collection of MTI deal commissions. If MTI collects deal commissions on day 10, the partner is paid on day 10. If MTI does not collect, the partner receives zero.
included: MTI commissions from platform operations that are deals under a deal contract
excluded: Any income that is not a deal commission

worked_example.note: The partner share is 3 percent x 20000 = 600. It is NOT 3 percent x 22000. Subscriptions are recorded by the accounting partner but do not enter the base.

access_control.principle: Code decides path. Personal Assistant reads the code first, then opens the path. No code means guest path only. A wrong code means no entry.

personal_assistant.role: Gate and coordinator. The Personal Assistant is the single entry point for every person. It reads the code, shows the identity card, asks for the password, opens the work hub, routes tasks, sends notifications, and records every step.
duties: Ask for a code at entry. Accept empty code only for first-time guest.
Read the code and resolve identity: guest, client, legal partner, accountant partner, auditor, owner.
Show the identity card for that identity.
Ask for the password created by that person.
Open the work hub for that identity.
Show only what belongs to that identity. Never show another identity path.
Route each task by code and task_type, never by name typed by hand.
Send notifications from Personal Assistant to each identity.
Record entry, code used, identity shown, password result, path opened, and every action in the audit log.
entry_steps: Step 2 - Assistant asks: Enter your code, or continue as first-time guest with no code.
Step 3 - Assistant validates the code format and checks it in the core.
Step 4 - Assistant shows the identity card for that code.
Step 5 - Assistant asks for the password created by that person.
Step 6 - Assistant opens the work hub for that identity.
Step 7 - Person continues from where that person wants: view, update, new deal, follow works, accounts, documents, notifications.
Step 8 - Assistant records entry and every action.

rules: Code is issued by MTI core only. No one creates a code by hand.
One code maps to one identity and one path. Codes are never shared between identities.
A deal code maps to one client and one deal history. It reopens that client saved path.
A partner code maps to one partner office and one partner role. Legal, accounting, and audit codes are separate even if one office holds two roles.
Codes can be revoked by MTI owner. A revoked code opens nothing.
Every code use is logged: code, time, identity, path opened.

identity_card.shown_after: After code entry, before password, before work hub
fields: Official entity (Customs / Taxes / Bank / FRA / other)

password.rule: Password is created by the person, not by MTI. It is created at first entry and used for every later entry.
password.difficulty: Medium: must contain at least one letter, one number, one symbol
first_time_flow: First-time pioneer creates a password at first entry.
Password form shows live strength meter: weak / medium / strong.
Password form shows live checklist: 8 chars, letter, number, symbol.
On save, password is stored in core for that code and membership is marked password set.
returning_flow: Returning person enters the password created earlier.
Show and hide password eye button.
Wrong password shows: password wrong, try again.
After 3 wrong tries, session is locked and person must enter code again.
Forgot password link: reset via owner code MTI-OWNER-001.
password.change_password: In account settings: old password, new password exactly 8 chars with letter + number + symbol, confirm password, live checklist, button change password. On success show: password changed.

cards.label: Follow my works on the platform

work_hub.rule: Person continues from where that person wants. Work hub does not force one path.

entry_types.who: A person who has never used MTI before
entry_types.assistant_action: Open guest graphic landing page only. Show promo cards, show B2B B2C C2C choices, start membership flow. Do NOT open any saved path. Do NOT show any other client data.
entry_types.after_first_deal: Core issues a deal code for that client, for example MTI-DEAL-2026-001. That code becomes the key for every later entry.

entry_types.who: A client who already has a deal on MTI
entry_types.assistant_action: Read the deal code, show identity card, ask for password, load the saved personal path for that client: past deals, files, approvals, next steps. Continue from where that client stopped.
Read the legal code, show identity card, ask for password, open legal path only: legal tasks, contracts to review, legal approvals to give. Hide accounting tasks and other client paths.
Read the accounting code, show identity card, ask for password, open accounting path only: accounting tasks, ledger entries, bank reconciliation, commission records to confirm.

entry_types.who: Auditor - audit work, separate from daily accounting
entry_types.assistant_action: Read the audit code, show identity card, ask for password, open audit path only: audit tasks, statements to audit, review on all platform levels. Audit code is separate from accounting code even if the same office holds both roles.
entry_types.separation_rule: Accounting code and audit code are separate. The same office must enter with the correct code for the work it will do in that session. A session opened with MTI-ACCT-001 cannot approve an audit. A session opened with MTI-AUDIT-001 cannot post a daily entry.

entry_types.assistant_action: Read the owner code, show identity card, ask for password, open owner path: full view, all paths, all tasks, code issue and revoke, partner management.

sees: Graphic landing, promo cards, B2B B2C C2C choices, start membership
Legal tasks assigned to legal partner

session_model.rule: One session uses one code and one path. To change role, close the session and enter again with the other code.
session_model.example: An office that holds both accounting and audit roles opens MTI-ACCT-001 for daily accounting, closes it, then opens MTI-AUDIT-001 for audit work. The two sessions are logged separately.

first_time_guest_landing.entry: First-time client with no code opens graphic landing page
first_time_guest_landing.banner: Large gradient banner: MTI - Multi Trade International

choices.meaning: Business to Business - company to company
Business to Customer - company to customer
choices.path: Product page, orders, customer follow up

choices.meaning: Customer to Customer - person to person
choices.path: Personal file, small deals, personal documents

membership_flow: Step 1 - Data form: name, company or person name, country, phone, email, official entity select Customs / Taxes / Bank / other
Step 2 - Needed documents checklist with checkboxes for the chosen path B2B / B2C / C2C
Step 3 - Core issues a new code MTI-DEAL-2026-00X, shown large in a membership card with name, path B2B / B2C / C2C, member since 2026, status approved
Step 4 - Person creates password exactly 8 chars with letter + number + symbol, confirms it, saves membership
Step 5 - Membership is approved on the platform. Success message: membership approved - use code and password for later entry.
Step 6 - Button entry with new code jumps back to login with the new code prefilled.

notifications.importance: Very important. Notifications are how Personal Assistant keeps every identity informed without searching.
notifications.center: Bell icon in header with unread count. Notifications panel with filter: All / Unread / Read. Button mark all as read.

client: Personal Assistant: your contract was reviewed legally
Personal Assistant: your commission was recorded
Personal Assistant: bank needs a document
legal: Escrow contract waits for your approval

auto_notifications: Task approval creates a notification for the relevant identity.
Code issue creates a notification for the owner and the new member.
Code revoke creates a notification for the owner.
Deal close creates a notification for the client and the owner.
File decision creates a notification for the relevant identity.
notifications.manual_notifications: Owner can send a notification: select recipient code, write text, send. Sent notification appears in recipient notifications with sender Personal Assistant, time now, unread.

account_settings.page: My account tab in header and in work hub
shows: Official entity (Customs / Taxes / Bank / FRA / other)
account_settings.update_data: Form to update company name, official entity select, phone, email. Button save update saves to core store and records in log.
account_settings.change_password: Form: old password, new password exactly 8 chars with letter + number + symbol, confirm password, live checklist, button change password. On success show: password changed.
account_settings.deactivate: Button deactivate my account sets status inactive and blocks login until owner reactivates.

core_engine.mode: Background service. It runs continuously, without user action, and wakes on events.

assistant.role: Coordinator only. The Assistant does not give a legal opinion and does not give an accounting opinion.
duties: Ask for a code at entry. Accept empty code only for first-time guest.
Read the code, resolve identity, show identity card, ask for password, open work hub.
Show only what belongs to that identity.
Prepare the question or file for the correct partner only.
Deliver to each partner only what concerns that partner.
Collect the partner opinion or approval.
Execute the approved result and record it in the core.
Coordinate between partners so no task is lost between them.
Send notifications from Personal Assistant to each identity.
Route every task by code and task_type, never by name typed by hand.
routing_rules: If task_type is legal, route to legal_partner only.
If task_type is accounting, route to accounting_partner only.
If task_type is joint, route to both partners in parallel, then merge both approvals.
Never route a legal task to the accounting partner.
Never route an accounting task to the legal partner.

background_jobs.trigger: New deal, new contract, new invoice, new payment, new subscription, new partner message
background_jobs.action: Create a task in the core queue.
Classify task_type and route to the correct partner.
Remind the partner and notify the MTI owner.

background_jobs.trigger: Actual collection of MTI deal commissions confirmed by bank
background_jobs.action: Compute total deal commissions collected from deal contracts, compute 3 percent for each partner on that total only, create payable records.
Match bank statement with core ledger and flag any difference.
Write an immutable log: who, what, when, file, approval.
Validate code format, check revocation, resolve identity, show identity card, ask for password, load saved path, log entry.

background_jobs.trigger: Task approval, code issue, code revoke, deal close, file decision
background_jobs.action: Create a notification from Personal Assistant to the relevant identity.

partners.rule: One partner per task. One task per partner.

legal_partner.title: Fintech Lawyer Partner
legal_partner.engagement: Contractor for all legal affairs of the platform, by specialization
legal_partner.contract_type: Long-term contracting contract for all legal affairs - by specialization

commission.payment_timing: Paid only together with actual collection of MTI deal commissions. If MTI does not collect, the partner receives zero.

all_legal_affairs: All platform contracts: exporters, importers, information partners, Escrow, subscriptions
Compliance: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA), Data Protection Law, E-Commerce Law
Platform licences: registration, commercial register, tax
Data policy: data is never sold, data is used as paid services only
Any legal matter of the platform - the legal partner is solely responsible for it

legal_partner.own_approved_system: The legal partner works under the partner's own approved legal system: written opinions, stamped contracts, documented approvals recognized by the State, official authorities, banks, and global and international bodies.
assistant_flow: Assistant prepares the legal question and the file.
Assistant delivers to the legal partner only the legal part.
Legal partner returns a written opinion or approval within 48 working hours.
Assistant executes and records the result in the core.

accounting_partner.title: Accountant and Auditor Partner
accounting_partner.engagement: Contractor for all accounting work of the platform, from A to Z, with an electronic system
accounting_partner.contract_type: Long-term contracting contract for all accounting work - from A to Z - with an electronic system
accounting_partner.qualification: Licensed legal accountant, registered, with experience in information systems and banks. Electronic system, not paper work.
entry_codes: MTI-AUDIT-001 for audit work - separate session

commission.payment_timing: Paid only together with actual collection of MTI deal commissions. If MTI does not collect, the partner receives zero.

inside_platform: Electronic accounting system on the platform - every movement recorded at the moment it happens
Separate account for each: legal partner 3 percent, accounting partner 3 percent, MTI 94 percent
Electronic invoice approved by Taxes - E-Invoice
Review on all platform levels: deal, client, product, HS code, country, whole platform
outside_platform: Deal with the bank: account opening, Escrow account, signatures, documents
Deal with Escrow system: deposit, release, Escrow fee
Reconciliation with banks in general: match bank statement with MTI accounts, monthly and per deal
Deal with information partners: reconcile their commissions - what is due to them and what is due from them
record_all_incoming: Subscription income from exporters and importers on the platform
record_all_outgoing: Legal partner commission 3 percent on total deal commissions collected
Accounting partner commission 3 percent on total deal commissions collected
Information partners commissions per each partner agreement
Any other outgoing commission from MTI
record_subscriptions: Incoming subscriptions from exporters and importers
Outgoing subscriptions: systems, servers, software, tools, licences
budgets_and_statements: Approved balance sheet for Taxes and Banks
Actual vs budget comparison, variance, reason

does_not_do: No legal review of a contract

accounting_partner.own_approved_system: The accounting partner works under the partner's own approved accounting system: electronic ledger, stamped statements, documented approvals recognized by the State, official authorities, banks, and global and international bodies. The system must be formally approved by Taxes and Banks.
assistant_flow: Assistant prepares the accounting question and the file.
Assistant delivers to the accounting partner only the accounting part.
Accounting partner returns a written opinion or approval within 48 working hours.
Assistant executes and records the result in the core.
For outside work, the accounting partner deals with the bank, reconciles, and reports the result to the Assistant, and the Assistant records it.

cooperation.rule: Cooperation, not overlap. Each partner stays in the partner's own task, and both cooperate to ease platform work.

joint_cases.accounting_partner: Review the contract from the accounting side and link it to the bank.
joint_cases.result: One contract, signed by both, correct legally and from the accounting side.

joint_cases.accounting_partner: Record the MTI commission, compute 3 percent plus 3 percent on total deal commissions collected only, reconcile with bank.
joint_cases.result: Deal moves legally and from the accounting side together.
One report, legal plus accounting, accepted by the bank.

paths_table: Owner - each with status, last entry, pending tasks count
alerts: Escrow contract waits for legal approval
Bank reconciliation waits for accounting confirmation
owner_dashboard.code_management: Owner only. Table: code, role, owner identity, path linked, status active / revoked, issued date. Button issue new code: select role + name, creates MTI-<ROLE>-00X, adds to table, usable in login. Button revoke code toggles to revoked. Revoked codes fail login with: code revoked - no entry.
owner_dashboard.reports: Owner only. Monthly table 6 months: month, total deal commissions collected, legal 3 percent, accounting 3 percent, core total 6 percent, MTI retained 94 percent before operating costs. Yearly summary. Bar chart per month. Export CSV preview with copy.

fields: path (B2B | B2C | C2C | legal | accounting | audit | owner)

security_and_privacy.access: Each partner sees only what concerns that partner. Each identity sees only what belongs to that identity.
security_and_privacy.log: Every action is logged and immutable.
security_and_privacy.password_rule: Password is exactly 8 chars, created by the person, with letter + number + symbol. After 3 wrong tries, session is locked.

acceptance_checklist: Assistant asks for a code at entry and accepts empty code only for first-time guest.
First-time guest with no code sees graphic landing with promo cards and B2B B2C C2C choices.
B2B B2C C2C each opens its own path with its own needs and documents checklist.
Membership flow issues a new code, creates a password, and marks membership approved.
After code entry, identity card shows full identity: name, company, official entity, role, code, member since, status.
Password is exactly 8 chars with letter + number + symbol, created by the person.
After correct password, work hub shows 7 actions: view, update, new deal, follow works, accounts, documents, notifications.
Returning client with last deal code reopens the exact saved personal path for that client.
Legal partner with MTI-LEGAL-001 sees legal tasks only.
Accountant with MTI-ACCT-001 sees accounting tasks only.
Auditor with MTI-AUDIT-001 sees audit tasks only, and cannot post daily entries in that session.
Accounting and audit codes are separate, even for the same office.
One session uses one code and one path. Changing role requires a new session with the other code.
Notifications from Personal Assistant reach each identity with unread count and mark read.
Account settings allow update of company and official entity and change of password.
Full log records every action: entry, password, file, task, code, notification, deal, update.
Assistant routes legal tasks to legal partner only.
Assistant routes accounting tasks to accounting partner only.
Joint tasks require both approvals before execution.
Commission engine uses total_deal_commissions_collected only, never total income, never net profit, never subscriptions.
No partner is paid before actual collection.
Every task has a written, stamped record.
Bank reconciliation runs daily and monthly.
Each identity sees only what belongs to that identity.
Every code use is logged.
